items.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run
items.job: Install new key rings and key insert or cover (recall fix)
items.note: Free under GM's ignition key recall. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: Timing chain stretch on the V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners (V6)
items.note: Ask a dealer if any coverage applies to your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the chain jumped and damaged the engine.

items.t: Steering shaft bolt may be loose
items.job: Inspect and tighten intermediate steering shaft bolt
items.note: Covered by a GM safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: Front brake hose fittings corrode and burst
items.job: Replace both front brake hoses and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by GM brake hose recalls for affected cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front lower control arm can separate
items.job: Inspect and replace front lower ball stud hardware or control arm
items.note: Covered by a GM safety recall. Check your VIN. Price is per side.

items.t: Airbags may deploy when the ignition is turned on
items.job: Replace airbag sensing and diagnostic module
items.note: Free under GM's airbag module recall. Check your VIN. Deployed airbags cost much more to replace.

items.t: Rear axle pinion seal leak
items.job: Replace rear differential pinion seal and refill gear oil
items.note: Free under GM's pinion seal recall. If the differential was damaged from low oil, expect much more.

items.t: V6 can lose fuel supply and stall
items.job: Reprogram engine control module
items.note: Free software update under GM's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: CTS-V fuel pump connector can overheat and leak
items.job: Replace fuel pump module and tank jumper harness
items.note: Free under GM's CTS-V fuel module recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor mat can fail
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant sensing mat
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag on/off logic error
items.job: Reprogram passenger sensing module
items.note: Free software update under GM's recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear toe link nuts can loosen
items.job: Install new rear toe link jam nuts and align
items.note: Free under GM's recall. If a toe link is damaged it gets replaced too. Check your VIN.

items.t: Roof-rail airbags may deploy from driveshaft vibration
items.job: Replace rear driveshaft assembly
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN. Deployed curtain airbags cost much more to replace.

items.t: Brake booster pushrod nut can loosen
items.job: Inspect and torque brake booster pushrod nut
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected 2012 cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: Chassis control module short can stall the car
items.job: Replace chassis electronic control module
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Cadillac dealer.

items.t: Shift cable can detach (car may roll away)
items.job: Inspect and reseat transmission shift cable at brackets
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected 2014 cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front seat weld may be incomplete
items.job: Inspect seat weld and replace lower seat track if needed
items.note: Covered by a GM recall. Check your VIN. Price is per seat if the track must be replaced.

items.t: Brake pedal bracket can break
items.job: Replace brake pedal bracket
items.note: Free under GM's recall for affected 2015 cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: CUE touchscreen freezes or delaminates
items.job: Replace CUE touchscreen panel (digitizer)
items.note: Aftermarket digitizers cost far less than a full dealer radio/display unit.

items.t: Eight-speed automatic shudders or shifts harshly
items.job: Transmission fluid flush and control module reprogram
items.note: Bulletin 18-NA-355 covers the flush; a torque converter may be needed if shudder stays.

items.t: Harsh shifts, slipping or loss of drive from automatic transmission faults
items.job: Replace transmission shift solenoids or control module
items.note: Pan-off solenoid work and a fluid service; a rebuild costs far more if the clutches are already slipping.
